sloka: अङ्गदस्तु रणे शत्रुं निहन्तुं समुपस्थितः ।रावणिं निजघानाशु सारथिं च हयानपि ।। ६.४४.२८ ।।।।
transliteration: aṅgadastu raṇe śatruṁ nihantuṁ samupasthitaḥ ।rāvaṇiṁ nijaghānāśu sārathiṁ ca hayānapi ।। 6.44.28 ।।।।

translations.english: Angada who was determined to kill the enemies, in no time wounded Ravana's charioteer and also the horses.
